bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
back="$r/scripts/.profile-topic-rollback-20261114"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null
cmp -s "$back/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
cmp -s "$back/userbot_test_client.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
restore(){ rc=$?; if test "$rc" -ne 0; then
 cp -p "$back/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
 cp -p "$back/userbot_test_client.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 echo TOPIC_DISCOVERY_SOURCE_RESTORED
 fi; }
trap restore EXIT
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,stat
r=Path("/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/scripts")
a=r/"userbot_resident_ipc.py";b=r/"userbot_test_client.py"
texts=[a.read_text(),b.read_text()]
if any("profile_topics_readback" in x for x in texts):raise SystemExit(74)
needle='    if action == "room_private_smoke":'
if texts[0].count(needle)!=1:raise SystemExit(75)
texts[0]=texts[0].replace(needle,"    if action == \"profile_topics_readback\":\n        # Telegram's USER API returns real forum topic IDs, not t.me/c message\n        # suffixes. Only inspect the three already-approved boards, read-only.\n        from telethon import functions\n        dialogs = await client.get_dialogs(limit=500)\n        targets = (\n            (\"area_bbs\", -1003847210571),\n            (\"video_chat\", -1002373696859),\n            (\"gay_board\", -1003770334893),\n        )\n        results = []\n        for board, chat_id in targets:\n            entity = next((d.entity for d in dialogs if d.id == chat_id), None)\n            if entity is None:\n                raise RuntimeError(\"PROFILE_READ_GROUP_NOT_IN_EXISTING_DIALOGS\")\n            forum = await client(functions.messages.GetForumTopicsRequest(\n                peer=entity, q=\"みんなのプロフ\",\n                offset_date=0, offset_id=0, offset_topic=0, limit=100))\n            matches = [t for t in forum.topics\n                       if \"みんなのプロフ\" in getattr(t, \"title\", \"\")]\n            if len(matches) > 1:\n                raise RuntimeError(\"PROFILE_READ_MULTIPLE_TOPICS\")\n            results.append({\"board\": board, \"chat_id\": chat_id,\n                            \"thread_id\": int(matches[0].id) if matches else None,\n                            \"found\": len(matches) == 1})\n        return {\"request_id\": request_id, \"action\": action, \"status\": \"PASS\",\n                \"topics\": results}\n"+needle,1)
texts[0]=texts[0].replace('ACTIONS = frozenset({','ACTIONS = frozenset({"profile_topics_readback", ',1)
needle2='"TARGET_NOT_BOT", "PEER_UID_NOT_ALLOWED",'
if texts[0].count(needle2)!=1:raise SystemExit(76)
texts[0]=texts[0].replace(needle2,'"PROFILE_READ_GROUP_NOT_IN_EXISTING_DIALOGS", "PROFILE_READ_MULTIPLE_TOPICS", '+needle2,1)
needle3='        if "row_sizes" in result:'
if texts[1].count(needle3)!=1:raise SystemExit(77)
texts[1]=texts[1].replace(needle3,"        if args.action == \"profile_topics_readback\":\n            topics = result.get(\"topics\")\n            if (not isinstance(topics, list) or len(topics) != 3\n                    or any(not isinstance(t, dict) or t.get(\"board\") not in\n                           {\"area_bbs\", \"video_chat\", \"gay_board\"}\n                           or type(t.get(\"found\")) is not bool\n                           or (t[\"found\"] and (type(t.get(\"thread_id\")) is not int\n                                                or t[\"thread_id\"] <= 0))\n                           for t in topics)):\n                raise RuntimeError(\"PROFILE_TOPICS_CONTRACT_INVALID\")\n            print(\"USERBOT_PROFILE_TOPICS=\" + json.dumps(\n                topics, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(\",\", \":\")))\n"+needle3,1)
for p,s in zip((a,b),texts):
 compile(s,str(p),"exec")
 tmp=p.with_name(p.name+".stage")
 with tmp.open("w") as f:
  f.write(s);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 os.chmod(tmp,stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode))
 os.replace(tmp,p)
print("TOPIC_DISCOVERY_SYNTAX_AND_STAGE=PASS")

PY
"$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -m py_compile "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 81
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 82
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 83
python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 84
echo USERBOT_PRESERVED_SESSION_AUTH=PASS
set +e
profile_out="$(python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" profile_topics_readback 2>&1)"
profile_rc=$?
set -e
if test "$profile_rc" -ne 0; then
 case "$profile_out" in
  *USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=PROFILE_READ_GROUP_NOT_IN_EXISTING_DIALOGS*) exit 86;;
  *USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=PROFILE_READ_MULTIPLE_TOPICS*) exit 87;;
  *USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=INTERNAL*) exit 88;;
  *USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=RESIDENT_USERBOT_NOT_AUTHORIZED*) exit 89;;
  *USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=BLOCKED*) exit 90;;
  *) exit 91;;
 esac
fi
echo "$profile_out" | grep -q 'USERBOT_PROFILE_TOPICS=' || exit 92
echo PROFILE_TOPIC_DISCOVERY=PASS
